cards.update_timing: Set before every approximately 2-second wheel direction stage
cards.failure_symptom: If stage identity is not observed, a wheel movement can be attributed to the wrong software direction.
cards.confirmed_fact: RR_FORWARD produces actual backward rotation and RR_REVERSE produces actual forward rotation.
cards.misconception_to_avoid: Do not infer both directions for LF, RF, or LR from a single observed movement.

cards.update_source: Pi raw CAR_POSE parser plus MCU-local calibration state
cards.update_timing: Immediately before the MCU emits a V2.3 0x81 task request or arms optional radar assistance
cards.failure_symptom: If false is bypassed in a scoring run, the car may still follow the line but cannot form a valid CalibrationId-bound air-task session.
cards.confirmed_fact: A valid raw current pose plus an MCU-local CalibrationId is required only to form the V2.3 task request; PG13/PG9 local line following does not call this predicate as a propulsion gate.
cards.misconception_to_avoid: Pi CALIBRATED flags or a legacy FA...AB stream do not create the MCU-local calibrated session, and their absence must not disable local line following.
cards.next_review: Before the first end-to-end Pi and air-radio field test

cards.update_timing: On each accepted flight state frame while task 2 is active
cards.failure_symptom: Unlocking at INTERCEPT can accelerate the car while the aircraft is still aligning, descending, or dwelling on the platform.
cards.confirmed_fact: Task 2 may unlock the fast vehicle envelope only after the aircraft has left the platform.
cards.misconception_to_avoid: INTERCEPT is not evidence of a completed platform landing and relaunch.

cards.update_timing: Once per 100 ms car slot while a local task session is idle and raw pose plus MCU-local calibration remain fresh
cards.failure_symptom: If 0x81 is queued before three current calibrated 0x80 frames, the aircraft can reject or ignore the task as an invalid session even though the car starts normally.
cards.confirmed_fact: Preamble count resets on stale pose, changed CalibrationId, or an intervening directed ACK; PG13/PG9 local propulsion remains independent of this count.
cards.misconception_to_avoid: Three 0x81 retries do not replace the required CAR_POSE preamble; they only make one already-valid task request reliable.
cards.next_review: First capture proving 0x80 x3 -> 0x81 x3 -> 0x11 ACK with radio_uart_err=0

cards.update_timing: Each 20 ms active control sample with any encoder count increment
cards.failure_symptom: If no progress is observed for 20 seconds after propulsion is armed, the vehicle performs a safety stop even though the 90-second lap window has not elapsed.
cards.confirmed_fact: The 20-second guard detects a jam or failed propulsion; it is not a normal-lap time limit.
cards.misconception_to_avoid: Do not replace the 90-second scoring watchdog with 20 seconds, or a normal 6 m low-speed lap will be cut off.
cards.next_review: First controlled stall and normal-lap test

cards.failure_symptom: If the X center offset, either mirror sign, or Delta order is wrong, the aircraft and ground station receive a position in the wrong place or quadrant.
cards.confirmed_fact: The current MCU output publishes X_lora = -(X_pi - 13 cm) + DeltaX, Y_lora = -Y_pi + DeltaY, and yaw_lora = yaw_pi while retaining raw Pi/radar coordinates for local assistance.
cards.misconception_to_avoid: Do not apply this output-only transform to Pi input, local line following, JY901, or encoder logic, and do not apply it a second time upstream.
